errors.evidence: The y-axis intervals are 200, not 100, as stated in the atom checklist (y_axis_range).

errors.text_span: стълбът за Китай/континентален достига приблизително 800 хиляди хектари
errors.evidence: China/continental reaches approximately 800 thousand hectares only in some years, but the description implies this as a general value, while the atom (max_value) states Spain has the highest values (~950). The description also misrepresents the relative scale.
The USA's values are closer to 400-450 thousand hectares, not 200, which is the approximate value for Argentina (min_value atom).
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates vineyard area in thousand hectares, as required by the atom (chart_type).
The description does not mention that the values for all countries remain stable over the years, as required by the atom (stability).

errors.text_span: осем държави: Аржентина, САЩ, Турция, Италия, Франция, Испания, Китай/континентален и САЩ
errors.evidence: The description lists the USA twice and omits the correct color mapping for France (gray) and China (orange). Only seven countries are present in the figure.

errors.text_span: Диаграмата представя промяната в площта на лозята в няколко държави
